verdict.rationale: Omnara's own docs say you can 'follow an agent's progress live' while it works, and you can interact through the dashboard, so real-time watching is a first-party capability. An explicit current-status indicator (e.g. running, paused, waiting for approval) is not documented. Hands-on corroboration is also absent. missing for 10: documented agent status states/indicator, detail on what the live view shows (tool calls, steps), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can watch what a running agent is doing in real time, including its current status

citations.quote: Follow an agent’s progress live, send a correction while it’s working, or queue up its next task.
Interact with agents directly through Omnara's dashboard or first-party Slack connector.
agents can pause to ask questions when they need your input.
